chunk.content: Some common names for Rastrelliger brachysoma, one of the fishes sold as gembolo, may also or exclusively refer to island mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni).
chunk.source_quote: Some common names listed for this species may also or exclusively be in use for R. faughni.

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2. Scombrids of the World (Collette & Nauen 1983), section incl. Rastrelliger
